details:
Some OSC apps require avatar parameter data either for functionality, validation of functionality (VF boop counter) or better UX (VRC face tracking)

Currently there is no way for OSC programs to know what avatar the user is wearing if the OSC program was launched in the middle of a VRChat session.

VRChat already sends us the avatar id of the avatar that the user is switching to via the /avatar/change endpoint.

I propose an endpoint to which OSC programs can send a query. Upon receiving the query, VRChat will send out a message that will contain the user's current avatar id.

As an example, the endpoint may be called /query/avatar_id to which you would send a true boolean tag. And consequently you would receive a response on the /response/avatar_id endpoint with a string tag of the avatar id.

For simplicity, the communication can be asynchronous as no concept of a response to a _specific_ message is required. You send a query to the query endpoint and at some point VRChat sends out a response on the response endpoint on the output socket.

Thank you.
title: Ability to Send an OSC Query that would respond with the current avatar of the user.
